page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.metal-48xl is a bare-metal, storage-optimized server powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor. It features 96 physical cores and 192 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with 1,536 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Local storage consists of 120,000 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a 200 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

The CPU includes 320 MB of L3 cache and supports specialized instruction set extensions, including AVX-512 and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX tile and int8). In benchmark testing, multi-core CPU execution ranks in the top tier across stress-ng, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core tests. Single-core processing benchmarks fall into the average to strong ranges depending on the specific workload.

Memory bandwidth measurements show top-tier throughput for cached small block reads as well as uncached large block reads and writes. Local I/O performance supports high throughput for database tasks, achieving top-tier status in PassMark database operations, Redis SET operations at over 214 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaching 215.95 GB/sec.

The server does not include discrete GPU accelerators, but CPU-based execution benefits from AMX extensions for LLM prompt processing. High resource density across storage, RAM, and compute capacity provides cost efficiency for infrastructure consolidation. The system is suited for high-capacity relational and NoSQL databases, data warehousing, and real-time transaction processing.
